gaps: P0: nothing; P2: only re-engraved copies of the 1581 plate (#9–#12), skipped
notes: #1–#8 and #10 are copies or details of the same Braun and Hogenberg plate. #11 (1659), #12 (1729, Van der Aa) and #9 (1719, Chatelain) are later re-engravings of the 1581 view, so they show the 16th-century city, not their own date. #18 Sleńdziński 1884 is a good color alternative for P4 but shows outer rooftops without main landmarks. #36 (2019 aerial) is a strong alternative for P6.
